title: Never do a gift swap with a Scorpio.
caption: Scorpio solved the whole secret gift swap in 2016, out loud, in front of everyone. In 2026 it used the same detective skills on the one thing you mentioned once in spring. Scary. Romantic. Send this to your Scorpio.
